A website design company you can actually reach

Most small business owners who come here have already paid for a website once. Some paid a deposit and waited weeks for a reveal. Some got a template with their name dropped into it. A few never got the login to their own domain. Dominion Web Design Pro works the other way around: Maurice Johnson builds a demo of your site first, you look at it on your own phone, and only then is there a price to talk about.

Every page on a finished site is written by hand for that business and the towns it serves. Nothing is filled into a template from a list of city names. That takes longer, and it is the reason the pages read like they were written by someone who looked at your business, because they were.

The business is based in Big Sandy, East Texas, and builds for local businesses anywhere in the country. Plumbers, roofers, law offices, therapists, salons, shops on the square: if customers search for you before they call you, the website is where that search lands.

How it works, start to finish

Four steps. The first two cost nothing, and you can stop after either of them.

  1. Ask for the demoGive your business name and what you do on the demo page, or call (903) 636-7511.
  2. Look at it on your phoneYou get a link to a site built for your business. Show it to whoever you show things to.
  3. Pick a package or walk awayStarter, Pro or Agency, one-time price. If it is not right, you owe nothing.
  4. Maurice writes and builds itEvery page written by hand, then launched on your domain, usually in 7 to 14 days for Starter.

Common questions

What does a website design company actually do for a small business?

It plans the pages, writes or edits the words, designs the layout, builds the site so it works on phones, connects the contact form and domain, and sets up the search basics: page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and schema. At Dominion Web Design Pro one person, Maurice Johnson, does all of that for your business, and you can call him about it.

Is there a web designer near me, or do you only work remotely?

Maurice works from Big Sandy in East Texas, so Tyler, Longview, Gilmer, Kilgore and the towns around them are close to home. Everywhere else, the work is done remotely: you see the demo by link, talk on the phone and approve pages by email. A website does not need a meeting room, and nobody here will pretend to have an office in your city.

How much does a website cost with you?

Three one-time prices: Starter is $497 for a 5-page site, Pro is $997 for 10 pages plus 10 city pages, and Agency is $1,997 for keyword research and a page for every town-and-service combination worth having. Hosting, maintenance and updates are included while you keep the AI agent, or $49 a month without it. Full details are on the pricing page.

Do I really see my website before I pay?

Yes. The free demo builds a preview site for your business name and trade. You look at it, show it around, and only then decide whether to buy a package. There is no deposit and no obligation.

Who answers when I call (903) 636-7511?

An AI receptionist answers any hour of the day. If you ask about a website preview, or ask for Maurice or a person, it transfers you to Maurice.

How long does it take to get a new website live?

The Starter site goes live in 7 to 14 days. On the Agency plan the pages arrive in waves as they are written, with the first ones live inside two weeks. What slows a site down most is waiting on photos and details, so having those ready helps.

Ready to see what your website could look like?

Give us your business name and what you do, and a demo site gets built for you to look at on your own phone. If you like it, pick a package. If you do not, you have spent nothing but the minute it took to look.
